newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia GDP points to good outlook-Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia GDP points to good outlook-Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that December quarter GDP data suggested a positive outlook for economic activity over coming quarters.

"Together with recent partial indicators on retail sales, building approvals, business investment expectations and employment, the December quarter national accounts point to a positive outlook for activity in coming quarters," Costello said in a statement.
